title: Travis Taylor zapped at Skinwalker Ranch

tellings.quote: Taylor was mouthing off and they give him this little zap, you know, with the the radioactivities.

plain: At Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange happenings, a man named Travis Taylor was "mouthing off" and was given "this little zap" involving radioactivity, according to the UFO researcher Grant Cameron. Cameron tells Michels this as something he has heard, without naming a source and without saying who or what did the zapping, and it is told as if the place itself answered back.
